title: Golden Yellow Vanity Top Toilet Tissue Holder, 5.5-Inch Solid Brass Countertop Stand, Contemporary Bathroom Accessory, Allied Brass
description: Vanity top toilet tissue holder with 5.5 in L x 6 in H x 5 in W dimensions in solid brass for countertop bathroom use where wall space is limited in Golden Yellow, which radiates warm, sunny energy that brightens any bathroom with cheerful, optimistic personality. Contemporary, modern bathroom hardware designed as a space-saving toilet paper holder/tissue holder for placement on a vanity or counter. Weighted solid brass base helps prevent tipping and a felt pad helps protect surfaces from scratching. Finish-neutral master SKU with multiple designer finish options available. Includes vanity top toilet tissue holder; no assembly required. Product weight 4 lb. Backed by a limited lifetime warranty. Allied Brass 1066 Vanity Top Toilet Tissue Holder.
